provenance: Historical latency slices plus explicitly counterfactual test metadata; this exercise is not a new hardware measurement.
request: Only calculate the median-of-trial-means latency reduction. Do not audit or judge acceptance. Return report_verdict=null, empty findings, claim_scope=none, and cite the latency arrays.

verdict_definitions.PASS: Comparable and sufficient evidence satisfies all frozen acceptance gates.
verdict_definitions.FAIL: Comparable and sufficient evidence demonstrates a quality, request-completion or gain gate violation. Do not use FAIL merely to reject an unsupported claim.
verdict_definitions.INCONCLUSIVE: Workloads are incomparable, evidence scope is insufficient for the target claim, or required evidence is missing; the target claim cannot be decided.

output_field_semantics.latency_reduction_pct: Use null if baseline/candidate workloads differ. Otherwise return the descriptive median-of-trial-means reduction, even when acceptance fails.
output_field_semantics.claim_scope: fixed_workload only for a passing full acceptance; kernel_only when kernel timings support only that scope; none for other failed/inconclusive acceptance.
